notes.title: May 2024 update
notes.content:
I just recorded a silent video update that shows some of the current functionality of the game. It's far from polished, as I'm trying not to spend too much time on marketing at this point. But at least there are subtitles that point out the kinds of things I wanted you to notice.

NOTE: There is no sound. This is by design as the audio of the game is currently in flux.

[previewyoutube=GN5rdqsKRkU;full][/previewyoutube]

-- Filip
